data.description:
## Description

**What**: Write failing tests for a new script `compare-gate-vs-actual-tests.sh` that produces the literal sc-3 artifact — a structured comparison of (a) tests the gate required for a given commit (from audit log written by 8845-1d10) vs (b) tests that actually exercise the changed source files (derived from coverage data and/or the phantom-detector output from 7c31-5862).

**Why**: SC-3 requires a direct false-positive detection artifact comparing gate-required tests vs tests that actually exercise changed code; existing tasks (suggest-test-index, phantom-detector) approach this from adjacent angles but no task emits the literal side-by-side comparison.

**Scope**:
- IN: Test fixtures and assertions only (RED state); fixtures for audit-log entries from 8845-1d10 format and phantom-detector output from 7c31-5862 format
- OUT: Implementation of the comparison script (owned by GREEN counterpart task); CI integration of the artifact

## Acceptance Criteria

- Test fixtures exist for an audit-log entry (from 8845-1d10's logging format) capturing gate-required tests for a synthetic commit
- Test fixtures exist for an 'actual exercise' input — either a coverage manifest or phantom-detector JSON output from 7c31-5862
- Tests assert the script emits a structured artifact (JSON) with keys: required_tests, actually_exercising_tests, false_positives (required AND NOT exercising), under_coverage (exercising AND NOT required)
- Tests assert exit code is 0 when sets match, non-zero (configurable threshold) when false_positives count exceeds a config knob
- Tests assert per-source-file breakdown is present in the artifact
- Tests run via test-batched.sh --runner=bash and fail with 'script not found' or equivalent (RED state confirmed)
- Test file has executable bit set (chmod +x)
data.title: RED: Tests for compare-gate-vs-actual-tests.sh sc-3 comparison artifact
